Name: CONFIG_AND_TOOLCHAIN_PREFLIGHT
Description: Resolve source/effective/resolved YAML, validate all keys, pin MATLAB/Toolbox/Git, create immutable RunID and seed ledger.

Name: FRAME_GRID_DUPLEX
Description: Exercise numerology, CP, carrier grid, TDD D/U/F ownership, BWP/CC timing and collision legality.

Name: WAVEFORM_DL_NOISELESS
Description: DL grid to CP-OFDM waveform to recovered grid; chunk continuity, Parseval, EVM and PSD.

Name: WAVEFORM_UL_NOISELESS
Description: UL CP-OFDM and single-layer DFT-s-OFDM spreading, mapping, despreading, continuity and PAPR.

Name: FIXED_SINR_DL_SWEEP
Description: Five-point fixed-SNR DL sweep using actual PDSCH/DL-SCH/waveform/receiver and measured post-EQ SINR.

Name: FIXED_SINR_UL_SWEEP
Description: Five-point fixed-SNR UL sweep using actual PUSCH/UL-SCH/UCI/waveform/receiver and measured post-EQ SINR.

Name: INITIAL_ACCESS_CONNECTED
Description: Blind PSS/SSS/PBCH/MIB, Type-0 CSS, SIB1, four-step RA, RRCSetupComplete and connected state.

Name: PDCCH_DCI_FORMAT_MATRIX
Description: Blind monitoring and contextual DCI 0_0/1_0 plus enabled 0_1/1_1 cases; wrong RNTI/size/no-signal negatives.

Name: PDSCH_DLSCH_MAPPING_MATRIX
Description: Mapping A/B, DM-RS types, PT-RS, rate matching, reserved REs, codeword/layer and HARQ contexts.

Name: PUSCH_ULSCH_UCI_MATRIX
Description: UCI Part 1/2, transform precoding, hopping, DM-RS/PT-RS, SRS authority, power and HARQ.

Name: PUCCH_UCI_FORMATS_0_TO_4
Description: Exercise formats 0-4 with HARQ-ACK, SR, CSI, resource selection, K1/TDD, hopping, power and negatives.

Name: REFERENCE_SIGNALS_MEASUREMENTS
Description: DM-RS, PT-RS, CSI-RS/CSI-IM, SRS, TRS, measured RSRP/RSRQ/SINR/EVM and collision checks.

Name: LINK_ADAPTATION_CSI_OLLA
Description: Decoded CSI Part 1/2, measured-only MCS/rank decisions, calibrated EESM/MIESM lookup and OLLA convergence micro-run.

Name: MIMO_ANTENNA_PRECODING
Description: Canonical arrays/polarization, Type-I codebook probes, rank 1/2/4, selected/applied matrix hashes and per-layer SINR.

Name: BEAM_MANAGEMENT_AND_BFR
Description: P1/P2/P3 measurement, report, TCI activation/application, beam blockage, failure detection and bounded recovery.

Name: CHANNEL_LOS_STATIC
Description: One-cell static LOS geometry with runtime distance/delay/pathloss/Doppler, TDL/CDL coefficients and absolute power.

Name: CHANNEL_NLOS_O2I_BLOCKAGE
Description: NLOS CDL-C/selected profile with O2I, material loss, oxygen where applicable, time-correlated blockage and measured channel state.

Name: MOBILITY_DOPPLER_CONTINUITY
Description: Moving UE with signed range-rate Doppler, channel phase continuity, measurement ageing and trajectory state.

Name: MULTICELL_WAVEFORM_INTERFERENCE
Description: Two cells/two UEs with sample-domain desired/interfering contributions, power ledger and covariance reconciliation.

Name: RF_CFO_TIMING_SCO_TRACKING
Description: Blind acquisition and correction of CFO, timing and SCO with persistent oscillator/resampler state.

Name: RF_PHASE_IQ_PA_ADC_BLOCKER
Description: Phase noise, IQ imbalance, PA memory, DPD/CFR bounded probe, DAC/AGC/ADC and blocker/intermodulation chain.

Name: UL_POWER_CONTROL_ALL_CHANNELS
Description: PUSCH, PUCCH, SRS and PRACH measured-pathloss power control, decoded TPC, PCMAX and waveform reconciliation.

Name: MAC_HARQ_SCHEDULER
Description: Event-sourced MAC, K0/K1/K2, HARQ identities, ACK/NACK/DTX, soft combining, BSR/PHR/SR/TA and RR/PF/QoS-PF probes.

Name: RLC_PDCP_SDAP_RRC
Description: RLC UM/AM, PDCP COUNT/security/reordering, SDAP QFI mapping, RRC reconfiguration and bearer commit.

Name: TRAFFIC_PACKET_LINEAGE
Description: Deterministic CBR and burst packets through SDAP/PDCP/RLC/MAC/TB/HARQ to first delivery with conservation.

Name: HANDOVER_RLF_REESTABLISHMENT
Description: Filtered measurement report, A3/TTT, target preparation, target RA, T304, completion; one failure/RLF/re-establishment branch.

Name: NEGATIVE_AND_FAULT_INJECTION
Description: Execute wrong identity/resource/timing/length, no-signal, stale state, collision, unsupported tuple and provenance faults.

Name: VALIDATION_ORACLES_STATISTICS
Description: Run schema-first gates, independent oracles, point joins, confidence intervals, deterministic merge and provenance checks.

Name: ALL_ARTIFACT_EXPORT_AND_AUDIT
Description: Generate, hash, schema-check and semantically audit every required CSV/PNG in the selected preset.

Name: WEBGUI_PUBLISH_AND_E2E
Description: Launch from canonical WebGUI, display source/effective/resolved YAML, live progress, all artifacts, validation and download/preview.

Name: COMPLETE_REPOSITORY_REGRESSION
Description: Run full MATLAB tests, Python tests, frontend tests and Playwright; no mandatory skip/block/fail.
